clue.text: Sail to Panama's capital? Brave

indicators.note: a capital is the head letter of a word, so only the start of the place name is kept

blocks.note: taken as written
the first letter of Panama
gallant means brave or valiant

explanation.surface: A query about a sailing trip to Panama City, followed by a bold verdict on the voyage.
explanation.walkthrough: TO + P + GALLANT. 'Panama's capital' tempts you towards Panama City; here it is just the initial letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A topgallant is the sail set above the topsail on a square-rigged mast.

clue.text: Symbolic pole — carry maiden under it
Bloodsucking fly, we hear — one following soldiers ahead
Military command to be ready with cases outside base

indicators.note: one word sitting outside another wraps around it, holding it within

blocks.note: legal cases are actions in court
a station is a military base or post

explanation.surface: An order for troops to prepare, with equipment cases stacked around the camp.
explanation.walkthrough: The wrap leaves only the final S of the outer word beyond the inner one, so the split falls very late.
explanation.definitionFit: Action stations is the order for troops or crew to take up positions ready for battle.

clue.text: Girl entertaining American tenor at the top of her voice?

definitions.text: at the top of her voice

indicators.note: to entertain a guest is to take them in, so one part holds the others

blocks.note: a girl's name
abbreviation for the United States
T is the abbreviation for tenor in music

explanation.surface: A young woman hosting a US singer belts out her song as loudly as she can.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the definition is an adverb, describing how something is done rather than a voice itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something lustily means with vigour and gusto, as when singing very loudly.

clue.text: Turning brown, Russian river, as is to be expected

indicators.note: turning a word around makes it read from back to front

blocks.note: tan is a light brown
the Ural flows through Russia and Kazakhstan

explanation.surface: A Russian river is turning brown, which is just what one would predict.
explanation.definitionFit: Natural can mean normal or expected, as in 'it's only natural that he was upset'.

clue.text: Type of music demonstrated by single on radio

indicators.note: what is on the radio is heard rather than read, so a word that sounds the same counts

blocks.note: sole means single or only

explanation.surface: A genre of music being showcased by a record released as a single on the radio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Single' suggests a record in the surface; here it means only one.
explanation.definitionFit: Soul is the genre of African-American popular music rooted in gospel and rhythm and blues.

clue.text: Mistaken about eccentric

blocks.note: out can mean wrong, as in 'your figures are out'
re means concerning or about

explanation.surface: Someone has got it wrong about a person who is odd.
explanation.definitionFit: Outré describes something unconventional or bizarre, beyond the bounds of propriety.

clue.text: In tears, lady somehow taught bad habits

indicators.note: somehow means in some unspecified way, so the letters are arranged in some other way

blocks.note: the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A weeping woman who has been corrupted into bad ways.
explanation.definitionFit: To be led astray is to be drawn into wrongdoing by others' influence.

clue.text: 12, say, in summer camp — I go mad about Romeo
Sailor's old books — one may have been taken from deck
Modelled at ancient city (date uncertain), wet through

indicators.note: uncertain means not fixed, so the letters are not settled in their order

blocks.note: an artist's model sits, so modelled is sat
Ur is the ancient Sumerian city
the letters rearranged

explanation.surface: An archaeologist posed at a dig of uncertain date and got soaked.
explanation.definitionFit: Something saturated is soaked so thoroughly it can hold no more liquid.

clue.text: Reg's sister most upset about one song

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the numeral is held inside the other letters
upset means knocked over or disturbed, so the letters are scrambled

blocks.note: the letters to rearrange
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A man named Reg's sister is most upset over a particular song.
explanation.definitionFit: Miss Otis Regrets is a Cole Porter song from 1934.

clue.text: Please pay in full

blocks.note: first meaning: to gratify or content someone
second meaning: to discharge a debt or claim completely

explanation.walkthrough: 'Please' reads as a polite request for payment; it is the verb meaning to gratify.
explanation.definitionFit: To satisfy is both to give contentment and to settle a creditor's claim in full.

clue.text: Incidental minor matter in fringe publication

blocks.note: a side is an edge or fringe
an issue is an edition of a publication

explanation.surface: A trivial story buried in an alternative magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: A side issue is a secondary point that distracts from the main question.

clue.text: Front runner eclipsing northern rowing club

indicators.note: eclipsing means covering over, so one part is enclosed by the other

blocks.note: the leader is the one in front
abbreviation for northern

explanation.surface: The race leader overshadows a rival from the north.
explanation.walkthrough: Leander Club at Henley-on-Thames is one of the oldest and most famous rowing clubs in England.
explanation.definitionFit: Leander is the name of a celebrated rowing club based at Henley-on-Thames.

clue.text: Flee with a nun — order flabbergasted
Make a speech, medical broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast also means scattered widely, as seed is, so the letters are spread into a new order

blocks.note: the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A doctor gives a talk on a health programme.
explanation.definitionFit: To declaim is to speak or recite rhetorically, as in delivering an oration.

clue.text: Cap, uncommon on metro

indicators.note: uncommon means unusual, so the letters take an unusual arrangement

blocks.note: the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A rare sight: a hat worn on the underground railway.
explanation.definitionFit: A montero is a Spanish huntsman's cap with flaps that cover the ears.

clue.text: Immediate amount of money girl wanted

blocks.note: a sum is an amount of money
a girl's name

explanation.surface: A young woman needs some cash straight away.
explanation.definitionFit: Summary as an adjective means done at once without formalities, as in summary dismissal.

clue.text: Have a busy social life after move abroad

indicators.note: one part coming after another places it later in the answer

blocks.note: a step is a single movement of the foot
abroad can mean out and about, out of doors

explanation.surface: Someone enjoys lots of parties after emigrating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Abroad' suggests a foreign country; its older sense is out of the house.
explanation.definitionFit: To step out is to go out socially, often to parties or on dates.

clue.text: This is it

blocks.note: surface reading: a statement that the moment has come
setter's reading: 'it' is the bar abbreviation in 'gin and it', naming a fortified wine

explanation.walkthrough: In a 'gin and it', the 'it' is short for a sweet fortified wine from Italy; the clue simply defines that abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: The drinker's shorthand 'it' stands for the sweet red aromatised wine of Italy mixed with gin.

clue.text: Girl a long time touring heart of Kenya

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its middle, so only its central letter is kept
touring means travelling around, so one part goes round the other

blocks.note: ages means a long time
the central letter of Kenya

explanation.surface: A young woman spends a long time travelling around Kenya.
explanation.definitionFit: Agnes is a female first name, and crosswords routinely define any such forename simply as a girl.

clue.text: Why Drogheda contains a health spa

indicators.note: the words contain the answer within them, spanning the gap between them

blocks.note: the letters run from inside the first word into the second

explanation.surface: A question about why an Irish town has a spa.
explanation.walkthrough: Drogheda is a town in County Louth, Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: A hydro is a hotel or establishment offering water treatments for health, a hydropathic spa.

clue.text: A backer in centre of resort here in Texas

indicators.note: the centre of a word is its middle, so only the central pair of letters is kept
in places one part inside another

blocks.note: the middle two letters of resort
the indefinite article, in its form before a vowel
an angel is a financial backer, especially of a theatre show

explanation.surface: A financial supporter is found in the middle of a holiday town in Texas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A' must be read as its pre-vowel form, and 'centre' here is the middle two letters of a six-letter word.
explanation.definitionFit: San Angelo is a city in west-central Texas, so it is a place found here in that state.

clue.text: Some controversy, no doubt, in council meeting

indicators.note: some of the following words means only part of their letters are used, in a run

blocks.note: the letters run across the three words

explanation.surface: A church council meeting where there is bound to be argument.
explanation.definitionFit: A synod is an assembly of clergy and church officials that meets to decide church affairs.

clue.text: Language contrary? Not half!

indicators.note: not half means one half is lost, so the first half of the word is dropped

blocks.note: perverse means contrary or obstinate

explanation.surface: Someone asks if a language is awkward and gets the British reply 'not half!', meaning very much so.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not half!' is British slang for 'absolutely'; here it says to drop half of PERVERSE, leaving its second four letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Erse is an old name for the Gaelic language of Scotland or Ireland.
